name: 10' Premium Rectangle Flag Pole
descriptionHtml:
Product Descrption

Materials:
Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester
Hardware: 100% epoxy fiberglass with lifetime warranty

Features:

Fiber glass poles are strong and flexible
Polished aluminum collar pole segment ends and ergonomic
Designed for use with universal flags (flags sold separately)
Flag attaches to a fixed hook on the pole using the included bungee tie kit
Carbon composite poles are strong and flexible
Uniform carbon composite overlay pole construction with high-gloss black paint finish
Polished aluminum collar pole segment ends and ergonomic, rubber-reinforced base grip
The inside diameter of the pole is 9/16" and the outside diameter is 3/4"
